Urban Water Reuse in Africa: Industrial Offtake, Public Water Priorities and Investment

African cities can develop an additional water resource by reclaiming wastewater, but a treatment plant alone does not establish a dependable supply or a viable customer contract. Durban's industrial reuse, Windhoek's potable-reclamation controls and Morocco's water-sector programme illuminate different parts of the decision: which water, for which user, under whose responsibility, and with what benefit to the wider system?
